lead: MSET refinery billing prices 2024 (local_prices_2024.csv rows from JAM-015)
result: Include SCT and fees per MSET definition (JAM-022 note 4). Rejected as pre-tax point.

lead: UN Comtrade HS 271019 import CIF 2024 (JAM-003)
result: 712.97 USD/t (16.581 USD/GJ). The code mixes diesel, jet, kerosene, heavy fuel oil and lubricants; MSET reports 2,598,438 bbl of Bunker C imported by alumina companies in 2024 inside the same code. Not a diesel price; kept as a price point only.

lead: OUR ADO price to JPS net of the specific SCT (local_prices_2024.csv)

result: Blocked: HTTP 302 to missing_key page; the API now requires a registered key. Not pursued (no account creation).

result: 2024 = 2.338 USD/gal (17.28 USD/GJ net with 326 gal/t and 44.1 GJ/t). Cargo price before freight to Jamaica; used as the lower check of the ASSUMPTION.

lead: MSET Energy Statistics 2025 Table 1 refined product imports by importer group
result: Refined products are reported only as one aggregate per importer group (refinery 95.93 USD/bbl, marketing companies 109.07 USD/bbl in 2024); no kerosene or jet split.

lead: MSET ex-refinery (pre-tax) kerosene price history (local_history.csv)

lead: Petrojam weekly kerosene 2024 mean
result: 167.619 J$/L (30.04 USD/GJ) including SCT; the SCT rate for kerosene in 2024 is not published in the sources found. Not usable as a pre-tax point.

lead: EIA price of liquefied US natural gas exports by vessel to Jamaica (annual)
result: US LNG cargoes to Jamaica every year 2018 to 2025 (13,201 MMcf in 2024 at 5.55 USD/Mcf FOB). Confirms US-sourced LNG; Henry Hub and the WEO United States gas series are used.

lead: UN Comtrade LNG (271111) import 2025 record
result: 1378.6 USD/t on about half the usual weight (28.7 USD/GJ against Henry Hub 3.52 USD/MMBtu); treated as a reporting error and excluded from observed values and from r.

lead: Gas calorific basis (rule F5)
result: Chosen point is per tonne of LNG with the IPCC net factor (already net). Henry Hub and generator-delivered prices per MMBtu are divided by 0.9 (gross to net).

lead: UN Comtrade coal (2701) import 2025 record
result: 245.64 USD/t on a weight Comtrade flags as estimated (2.6 times the Richards Bay benchmark); excluded from observed values and from r.

lead: World Bank Pink Sheet annual: Colombian coal series
result: No Colombian coal column in the annual file; South African (fob Richards Bay NAR 6000 kcal/kg) used as the Atlantic-basin observed benchmark.

lead: WEO 2025 Table 2.3 steam coal series
result: Series: United States (mine mouth plus transport, domestic), European Union (imports only), Japan, Coastal China. Jamaica's coal comes by sea mainly from the US export market (Comtrade mirror JAM-004); the European Union import series is the WEO Atlantic seaborne price and is used.

lead: Free international petroleum coke benchmark
url_or_query: EIA and World Bank data pages
result: None free; coal benchmark and WEO steam coal used because fuel-grade petcoke is sold against seaborne thermal coal.

lead: Model structure: outputs of DIST_OPE (BAU OutputActivityRatio)
result: DIST_OPE outputs E1COK, the same commodity as DIST_COK, with no activity limits on either row. Priced as DIST_COK.

lead: MSET Energy Statistics 2025 Table 1 imports of other petroleum products
result: No product split beyond crude; refined products; ethanol; Bunker C; petcoke. Petcoke (cement company) is the only E1COK import with a published value.
